title: SEBI Mandates Registered Name, Number Disclosure on Social Media
theme: SEBI Mandates Registered Name, Number Disclosure on Social Media
attentionJustification: Enforceable regulatory circular issued by RBI/SEBI/DICGC.

constituentArticles.title: SEBI Mandates Registered Name, Number Disclosure on Social Media
constituentArticles.text: SEBI directed all regulated entities (brokers, mutual funds, portfolio managers) to prominently display registration name and number across social media from May 1.

keyFacts: SEBI directed all regulated entities (brokers, mutual funds, portfolio managers) to prominently display registration name and number across social media from May 1.
